text: *ST萃华公告，公司因涉嫌信息披露违法违规于2026年2月9日被中国证监会立案调查。截至2026年8月6日，根据监管调查情况，现已初步查明，公司披露的部分年度财务信息涉嫌虚假记载，可能触及重大违法强制退市情形。若后续经中国证监会行政处罚认定的事实触及相关规定，公司股票将被实施重大违法强制退市。同时，公司于2026年8月6日收到深圳证券交易所下发的《关于对公司的关注函》。
text_en: *ST Cuihua announced that the company was placed under investigation by the CSRC on February 9, 2026 for suspected violations of information disclosure regulations. As of August 6, 2026, based on regulatory investigation findings, it has been preliminarily determined that some annual financial information disclosed by the company is suspected of false records, which may trigger mandatory delisting for major violations. If facts subsequently confirmed by CSRC administrative penalties fall under relevant regulations, the company's stock will be subject to mandatory delisting for major violations. Meanwhile, the company received a 'Letter of Concern' from the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on August 6, 2026.
